name: Broken Tears

meta.previous: Assault on the Kolkar, Magram Alliance

summary: In the Gelkis village cave, Warug wants you to break the crystals they call the tears of Theradras. He asks for three broken pieces, claiming the centaur mother cannot protect them.

sections.title: Crystals in the Cave
sections.body: Warug mocks the Gelkis for trusting Theradras, mother of the centaur, to protect them. He says no one protects the centaur, while the Magram are strongest and need no protection. In a cave in the Gelkis village, the Gelkis hoard crystals called the tears of Theradras. Warug sends you to smash them and bring him three broken pieces. He trusts you with this only if you are no enemy of the Magram.

sections.title: Warug's Boast
sections.body: Warug welcomes the broken crystals. He says the Gelkis will learn Theradras cannot help them, and no tears of hers will fall when the Magram crush them. The Magram will rule, he declares. You are wise to side with the strongest.

faq.answer: Warug is a Magram centaur in Magram Village in Desolace. He asks you to destroy the tears of Theradras in the Gelkis cave.

faq.q: What are the tears of Theradras?
faq.answer: The tears of Theradras are crystals the Gelkis hoard in a cave in their village.

faq.q: Why does Warug want the tears destroyed?
faq.answer: The Gelkis believe Theradras, the centaur mother, protects them. Warug calls them foolish and says the Magram need no protection. He wants to show the Gelkis they are wrong.
The crystals are in a cave in the Gelkis village. Warug asks you to bring him three broken pieces.
